correctness.rationale: The two directed path types through a large-shore vertex cannot coexist: any simple directed cycle must alternate through the two small-shore vertices and thus use both types. Inclusion–exclusion on the allowed words gives 2(z+2)^n−(z+1)^n before adding the small-shore sinks: among the 2^(n+1)−1 words with no large-shore sink, the all-outward large-shore word has two small-shore sinks, the others one. The formula has positive nonconstant coefficients and simple zero at 0. For z=−u, 0<u≤2, the geometric sum bound 1−(1−u)^n≤nu and (2−u)^n≤2^n give S_n(−u)≤u[n+u−(2^(n+1)−2)]<0. After z=−x−2, the even n≥4 polynomial has just one positive leading coefficient, all lower coefficients negative; the odd n≥5 polynomial has negative leading, positive middle and negative linear and constant coefficients. Descartes bounds the respective positive-root totals counting multiplicities by one and two. The signs at x=0 and infinity and, for odd n, the strict witness F_n=Q_n(3)>0 force exactly those counts and simplicity. Independently checked F_5=190 and F_{n+1}−4F_n=2·3^n+24·2^n−108>0 for n≥5. At n=2 the polynomial is 2z(z+6), and at n=3 the factor z²+10z+35 is strictly positive on the real line. The closing phrase ‘smallest parameter’ should be read as smallest odd parameter; the exact census is unambiguous. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproduce_reviews.py 1 independently compared the full coefficient histogram for n=2..8, using directed reachability to reject cycles, and confirmed the sampled odd witnesses. The all-n argument is symbolic.
